name: hh-agent
description: Toolkit for searching, applying, and tracking vacancies on hh.ru with Telegram integration

skills.search: Search hh.ru for vacancies matching a query. Supports salary filter, date range, multi-page.
skills.apply: Apply to a vacancy with a cover letter. Popup-first flow: fills letter before submitting. Fallback to quick apply.
skills.verify: Check if already applied to a vacancy. View active negotiations.
skills.auth: Manage hh.ru authentication (login with browser, check cookie status).
skills.telegram: Send messages via Telegram bot. Read incoming messages from inbox file.
skills.cv-design: Generate CV PDF via browser, deliver via Telegram.

setup: pip install -e . && playwright install chromium && hh auth login
